serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: You got the money?
You: W-well, about that… How about I pay you, uhm, later?
Landlord: You don’t have money?! Ha! You really are retarded! You got an hour to get the hell out of here!
You: J-just give me a little more time! I’m gonna get 800$ anytime soon! Have a heart man!
Landlord: Forget it! I told you before, didn’t I? Why would I keep such a loafer? There are people that will pay me more and pay regularly for this flat.
Landlord: You have an hour, kapish?!\n
#Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.5)
A-am I really gonna get kicked out? Shit! It’s freezing outside.
Maybe I should wait and see? There is no way that his thugs will kick me out right off the bat.
Y-yeah, no stress! I got at least a few days.
